descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for skilled engineers to join our team in the Bucharest office in delivering network and network security solutions to our global clients.
 Although we provide below a list of requirements and responsibilities, we are looking for talented and skilled colleagues.
 So if you feel comfortable discussing at a professional level about any of these topics, we invite you to apply to this job and wait for a call from us. 
 Requirements 
Solid knowledge of network and/or security principles and practices
Experience in configuring firewalls, switches/routers is a plus
CCNA/CCNP is a plus
Security and cloud certifications/skills are a plus
Strong time management and resource management skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Good communication skills, fluent in English, other languages represent a plus
High motivation, flexibility and productivity
 Responsibilities 
Network and network security infrastructure L2 activities
Firewall L2 support for one of our global clients
Physical installation of network devices and services in enterprise environment (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, access-points, wireless controllers)
Configuration changes on network devices and network applications, based on an existing change management processes
